newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Aiwa sees about 10 pct sales growth FY97.
newsitem.headline: Aiwa sees about 10 pct sales growth FY97.

text.p: Aiwa Co Ltd, a unit of Sony Corp, said on Tuesday it expected sales growth of about 10 percent in its 1997 financial year ending March 31, 1998.
Yoshio Ishigaki, president of Aiwa Co, told a news briefing in Singapore: "About a 10 percent increase in sales can be expected for FY97."
For its last fiscal year, ended March 31, 1996, Aiwa reported consolidated sales of 297 billion yen and a consolidated net profit of 5.31 billion yen.
Ishigaki earlier told the briefing he expected consolidated sales of 310 billion yen and a consolidated net profit of 5.4 billion yen for its 1996 fiscal year ended March 31, 1997.
